PEExcel is developed by the Climate-fit Buildings and Districts research group at FH Technikum Wien. The tool supports hourly modelling and the assessment of positive-energy districts, building services, mobility and life-cycle greenhouse gas emissions.

## Method and source material

The [training presentation](../downloads/schulung.pdf) describes the workbook workflow and the PEQ assessment. The [handbook](../downloads/handbuch.pdf) and [background guide](../downloads/hintergrund.pdf) provide further German-language context.

The [example results](examples.qmd) are generated from the supplied project exports. Each chart identifies its data source; the example calculations are not a declaration review.

## Software and reproducibility

The repository contains the Excel interface, the `pexl` Python package and executable analysis notebooks. Source, version and processing assumptions should be retained when reproducing a result.
